constants.buttons_min_height: The minimum height of each button in the bottom row (such as OK/Cancel) in pixels. This can be increased to make buttons with short texts easier to click/tap.

constants.align_to_largest_stylebox: This constant acts as a boolean. If true, the minimum size of the button and text/icon alignment is always based on the largest stylebox margins, otherwise it's based on the current button state stylebox margins.
constants.h_separation: The horizontal space between Button's icon and text. Negative values will be treated as 0 when used.
constants.icon_max_width: The maximum allowed width of the Button's icon. This limit is applied on top of the default size of the icon, or its expanded size if expand_icon is true. The height is adjusted according to the icon's ratio. If the button has additional icons (e.g. CheckBox), they will also be limited.
constants.line_spacing: Additional vertical spacing between lines (in pixels), spacing is added to line descent. This value can be negative.
constants.outline_size: The size of the text outline. Note: If using a font with FontFile.multichannel_signed_distance_field enabled, its FontFile.msdf_pixel_range must be set to at least twice the value of outline_size for outline rendering to look correct. Otherwise, the outline may appear to be cut off earlier than intended.

font_sizes.font_size: Font size of the Button's text.

icons.icon: Default icon for the Button. Appears only if icon is not assigned.

A StyleBox that represents an outline or an underline works well for this purpose. To disable the focus visual effect, assign a StyleBoxEmpty resource. styles.pressed_mirrored: StyleBox used when the Button is being pressed (for right-to-left layouts).

constants.item_start_padding: Horizontal padding to the left of the items (or right, in RTL layout).
constants.outline_size: The size of the item text outline. Note: If using a font with FontFile.multichannel_signed_distance_field enabled, its FontFile.msdf_pixel_range must be set to at least twice the value of outline_size for outline rendering to look correct. Otherwise, the outline may appear to be cut off earlier than intended.
constants.search_bar_separation: The vertical space between search bar and menu items.
constants.separator_outline_size: The size of the labeled separator text outline.
constants.v_separation: The vertical space between each menu item.

font_sizes.font_separator_size: Font size of the labeled separator.
font_sizes.font_size: Font size of the menu items.

fonts.font: Font used for the menu items.
fonts.font_separator: Font used for the labeled separator.

icons.checked: Texture2D icon for the checked checkbox items.
icons.checked_disabled: Texture2D icon for the checked checkbox items when they are disabled.
icons.indeterminate: Texture2D icon for the indeterminate checkbox items.
icons.indeterminate_disabled: Texture2D icon for the indeterminate checkbox items when they are disabled.
icons.radio_checked: Texture2D icon for the checked radio button items.
icons.radio_checked_disabled: Texture2D icon for the checked radio button items when they are disabled.
icons.radio_unchecked: Texture2D icon for the unchecked radio button items.
icons.radio_unchecked_disabled: Texture2D icon for the unchecked radio button items when they are disabled.
icons.search: Texture2D icon for the search bar's search icon.
icons.submenu: Texture2D icon for the submenu arrow (for left-to-right layouts).
icons.submenu_mirrored: Texture2D icon for the submenu arrow (for right-to-left layouts).
icons.unchecked: Texture2D icon for the unchecked checkbox items.
icons.unchecked_disabled: Texture2D icon for the unchecked checkbox items when they are disabled.

styles.hover: StyleBox displayed when the PopupMenu item is hovered.
styles.labeled_separator_left: StyleBox for the left side of labeled separator. See add_separator.
styles.labeled_separator_right: StyleBox for the right side of labeled separator. See add_separator.
styles.separator: StyleBox used for the separators. See add_separator.

colors.font_outline_color: The tint of text outline of the ProgressBar.

constants.outline_size: The size of the text outline. Note: If using a font with FontFile.multichannel_signed_distance_field enabled, its FontFile.msdf_pixel_range must be set to at least twice the value of outline_size for outline rendering to look correct. Otherwise, the outline may appear to be cut off earlier than intended.

font_sizes.font_size: Font size used to draw the fill percentage if show_percentage is true.

fonts.font: Font used to draw the fill percentage if show_percentage is true.

styles.fill: The style of the progress (i.e. the part that fills the bar).

colors.font_outline_color: The default tint of text outline.
colors.font_selected_color: The color of selected text, used when selection_enabled is true. If equal to Color(0, 0, 0, 0), it will be ignored.
colors.font_shadow_color: The color of the font's shadow.
colors.selection_color: The color of the selection box.
colors.table_even_row_bg: The default background color for even rows.
colors.table_odd_row_bg: The default background color for odd rows.

constants.line_separation: Additional vertical spacing between lines (in pixels), spacing is added to line descent. This value can be negative.
constants.outline_size: The size of the text outline. Note: If using a font with FontFile.multichannel_signed_distance_field enabled, its FontFile.msdf_pixel_range must be set to at least twice the value of outline_size for outline rendering to look correct. Otherwise, the outline may appear to be cut off earlier than intended.
constants.paragraph_separation: Additional vertical spacing between paragraphs (in pixels). Spacing is added after the last line. This value can be negative.
constants.shadow_offset_x: The horizontal offset of the font's shadow.
constants.shadow_offset_y: The vertical offset of the font's shadow.
constants.shadow_outline_size: The size of the shadow outline.
constants.strikethrough_alpha: The default strikethrough color transparency (percent). For strikethroughs with a custom color, this theme item is only used if the custom color's alpha is 0.0 (fully transparent).
constants.table_h_separation: The horizontal separation of elements in a table.
constants.table_v_separation: The vertical separation of elements in a table.
constants.text_highlight_h_padding: The horizontal padding around boxes drawn by the fgcolor and bgcolor tags. This does not affect the appearance of text selection. To avoid any risk of neighboring highlights overlapping each other, set this to 0 to disable padding.
constants.text_highlight_v_padding: The vertical padding around boxes drawn by the fgcolor and bgcolor tags. This does not affect the appearance of text selection. To avoid any risk of neighboring highlights overlapping each other, set this to 0 to disable padding.
constants.underline_alpha: The default underline color transparency (percent). For underlines with a custom color, this theme item is only used if the custom color's alpha is 0.0 (fully transparent).

font_sizes.bold_font_size: The font size used for bold text.
font_sizes.bold_italics_font_size: The font size used for bold italics text.
font_sizes.italics_font_size: The font size used for italics text.
font_sizes.mono_font_size: The font size used for monospace text.

fonts.bold_font: The font used for bold text.
fonts.bold_italics_font: The font used for bold italics text.
fonts.italics_font: The font used for italics text.
fonts.mono_font: The font used for monospace text.

styles.focus: The background used when the RichTextLabel is focused. The focus StyleBox is displayed over the base StyleBox, so a partially transparent StyleBox should be used to ensure the base StyleBox remains visible. A StyleBox that represents an outline or an underline works well for this purpose. To disable the focus visual effect, assign a StyleBoxEmpty resource. Note that disabling the focus visual effect will harm keyboard/controller navigation usability, so this is not recommended for accessibility reasons.
styles.normal: The normal background for the RichTextLabel.

constants.icon_max_size: The maximum allowed size of the ScrollBar's increment and decrement icons. The texture is scaled down so its widest axis is icon_max_size and the other axis is scaled keeping the original ratio.

icons.decrement: Icon used as a button to scroll the ScrollBar left/up. Supports custom step using the ScrollBar.custom_step property.
icons.decrement_highlight: Displayed when the mouse cursor hovers over the decrement button.
icons.decrement_pressed: Displayed when the decrement button is being pressed.
icons.increment: Icon used as a button to scroll the ScrollBar right/down. Supports custom step using the ScrollBar.custom_step property.
icons.increment_highlight: Displayed when the mouse cursor hovers over the increment button.
icons.increment_pressed: Displayed when the increment button is being pressed.

styles.grabber: Used as texture for the grabber, the draggable element representing current scroll.
styles.grabber_highlight: Used when the mouse hovers over the grabber.
styles.grabber_pressed: Used when the grabber is being dragged.
styles.scroll: Used as background of this ScrollBar.
styles.scroll_focus: Used as background when the ScrollBar has the GUI focus.

colors.scroll_hint_horizontal_color: Color used to modulate the scroll_hint_horizontal texture.
colors.scroll_hint_vertical_color: Color used to modulate the scroll_hint_vertical texture.

constants.scrollbar_h_separation: The space between the ScrollContainer's vertical scroll bar and its content, in pixels. No space will be added when the content's minimum size is larger than the ScrollContainer's size.
constants.scrollbar_margin_bottom: The bottom margin of the horizontal scrollbar. When negative, uses panel's bottom margin.
constants.scrollbar_margin_left: The left margin of the horizontal scrollbar. When negative, uses panel's left margin.
constants.scrollbar_margin_right: The right margin of the horizontal scrollbar. When negative, uses panel's right margin.
constants.scrollbar_margin_top: The top margin of the horizontal scrollbar. When negative, uses panel's top margin.
constants.scrollbar_v_separation: The space between the ScrollContainer's horizontal scroll bar and its content, in pixels. No space will be added when the content's minimum size is larger than the ScrollContainer's size.

icons.scroll_hint_horizontal: The indicator that will be shown when the content can still be scrolled horizontally. See scroll_hint_mode.
icons.scroll_hint_vertical: The indicator that will be shown when the content can still be scrolled vertically. See scroll_hint_mode.

styles.focus: The focus border StyleBox of the ScrollContainer. Only used if draw_focus_border is true.
styles.panel: The background StyleBox of the ScrollContainer.

constants.separation: The size of the area covered by the separator. Effectively works like a minimum width/height.

styles.separator: The style for the separator line. Works best with StyleBoxLine (remember to enable StyleBoxLine.vertical for VSeparator).

constants.center_grabber: Boolean constant. If 1, the grabber texture size will be ignored and it will fit within slider's bounds based only on its center position.
constants.grabber_max_size: The maximum allowed size of the Slider's grabber icon. The grabber texture is scaled down so its widest axis is grabber_max_size and the other axis is scaled keeping the original ratio.
constants.grabber_offset: Vertical or horizontal offset of the grabber.
constants.tick_max_size: The maximum allowed size of the Slider's tick icons. The tick texture is scaled down so its widest axis is tick_max_size and the other axis is scaled keeping the original ratio.
constants.tick_offset: Vertical or horizontal offset of the ticks. The offset is reversed for top or left ticks.

icons.grabber: The texture for the grabber (the draggable element).
icons.grabber_disabled: The texture for the grabber when it's disabled.
icons.grabber_highlight: The texture for the grabber when it's focused.
icons.tick: The texture for the ticks, visible when Slider.tick_count is greater than 0.

styles.grabber_area: The background of the area to the left or bottom of the grabber.
styles.grabber_area_highlight: The background of the area to the left or bottom of the grabber that displays when it's being hovered or focused.
styles.slider: The background for the whole slider. Affects the height or width of the grabber_area.

colors.down_disabled_icon_modulate: Down button icon modulation color, when the button is disabled.
colors.down_hover_icon_modulate: Down button icon modulation color, when the button is hovered.
colors.down_pressed_icon_modulate: Down button icon modulation color, when the button is being pressed.
colors.up_disabled_icon_modulate: Up button icon modulation color, when the button is disabled.
colors.up_hover_icon_modulate: Up button icon modulation color, when the button is hovered.
colors.up_pressed_icon_modulate: Up button icon modulation color, when the button is being pressed.

constants.buttons_vertical_separation: Vertical separation between the up and down buttons.
constants.buttons_width: Width of the up and down buttons. If smaller than any icon set on the buttons, the respective icon may overlap neighboring elements. If smaller than 0, the width is automatically adjusted from the icon size.
constants.field_and_buttons_separation: Width of the horizontal separation between the text input field (LineEdit) and the buttons.
constants.icon_max_width: The maximum allowed width of the SpinBox's up and down icons. The height is adjusted according to the icon's ratio.
constants.set_min_buttons_width_from_icons: If not 0, the minimum button width corresponds to the widest of all icons set on those buttons, even if buttons_width is smaller.

icons.down: Down button icon, displayed in the middle of the down (value-decreasing) button.
icons.down_disabled: Down button icon when the button is disabled.
icons.down_hover: Down button icon when the button is hovered.
icons.down_pressed: Down button icon when the button is being pressed.
icons.up: Up button icon, displayed in the middle of the up (value-increasing) button.
icons.up_disabled: Up button icon when the button is disabled.
icons.up_hover: Up button icon when the button is hovered.
icons.up_pressed: Up button icon when the button is being pressed.
icons.updown: Single texture representing both the up and down buttons icons. It is displayed in the middle of the buttons and does not change upon interaction. If a valid icon is assigned, it will replace up and down.

styles.down_background: Background style of the down button.
styles.down_background_disabled: Background style of the down button when disabled.
styles.down_background_hovered: Background style of the down button when hovered.
styles.down_background_pressed: Background style of the down button when being pressed.
styles.field_and_buttons_separator: StyleBox drawn in the space occupied by the separation between the input field and the buttons.
styles.up_background: Background style of the up button.
styles.up_background_disabled: Background style of the up button when disabled.
styles.up_background_hovered: Background style of the up button when hovered.
styles.up_background_pressed: Background style of the up button when being pressed.
styles.up_down_buttons_separator: StyleBox drawn in the space occupied by the separation between the up and down buttons.

colors.touch_dragger_color: The color of the touch dragger.
colors.touch_dragger_hover_color: The color of the touch dragger when hovered.
colors.touch_dragger_pressed_color: The color of the touch dragger when pressed.

constants.autohide: Boolean value. If 1 (true), the grabbers will hide automatically when they aren't under the cursor. If 0 (false), the grabbers are always visible. The dragger_visibility must be DRAGGER_VISIBLE.
constants.minimum_grab_thickness: The minimum thickness of the area users can click on to grab a split bar. This ensures that the split bar can still be dragged if separation or h_grabber / v_grabber's size is too narrow to easily select.
constants.separation: The split bar thickness, i.e., the gap between each child of the container. This is overridden by the size of the grabber icon if dragger_visibility is set to DRAGGER_VISIBLE, or DRAGGER_HIDDEN, and separation is smaller than the size of the grabber icon in the same axis. Note: To obtain separation values less than the size of the grabber icon, for example a 1 px hairline, set h_grabber or v_grabber to a new ImageTexture, which effectively sets the grabber icon size to 0 px.

icons.grabber: The icon used for the grabbers drawn in the separations. This is only used in HSplitContainer and VSplitContainer. For SplitContainer, see h_grabber and v_grabber instead.
icons.h_grabber: The icon used for the grabbers drawn in the separations when vertical is false.
icons.h_touch_dragger: The icon used for the drag handle when touch_dragger_enabled is true and vertical is false.
icons.touch_dragger: The icon used for the drag handle when touch_dragger_enabled is true. This is only used in HSplitContainer and VSplitContainer. For SplitContainer, see h_touch_dragger and v_touch_dragger instead.
icons.v_grabber: The icon used for the grabbers drawn in the separations when vertical is true.
icons.v_touch_dragger: The icon used for the drag handle when touch_dragger_enabled is true and vertical is true.

styles.split_bar_background: Determines the background of the split bar if its thickness is greater than zero.

colors.drop_mark_color: Modulation color for the drop_mark icon.
colors.font_hovered_color: Font color of the currently hovered tab. Does not apply to the selected tab.
colors.font_outline_color: The tint of text outline of the tab name.
colors.font_selected_color: Font color of the currently selected tab.
colors.font_unselected_color: Font color of the other, unselected tabs.
colors.icon_hovered_color: Icon color of the currently hovered tab. Does not apply to the selected tab.
colors.icon_selected_color: Icon color of the currently selected tab.
colors.icon_unselected_color: Icon color of the other, unselected tabs.

constants.h_separation: The horizontal separation between the elements inside tabs.
constants.hover_switch_wait_msec: During a drag-and-drop, this is how many milliseconds to wait before switching the tab.
constants.icon_max_width: The maximum allowed width of the tab's icon. This limit is applied on top of the default size of the icon, but before the value set with set_tab_icon_max_width. The height is adjusted according to the icon's ratio.
constants.outline_size: The size of the tab text outline. Note: If using a font with FontFile.multichannel_signed_distance_field enabled, its FontFile.msdf_pixel_range must be set to at least twice the value of outline_size for outline rendering to look correct. Otherwise, the outline may appear to be cut off earlier than intended.
constants.tab_separation: The space between tabs in the tab bar.

font_sizes.font_size: Font size of the tab names.

fonts.font: The font used to draw tab names.

icons.close: The icon for the close button (see tab_close_display_policy).
icons.decrement: Icon for the left arrow button that appears when there are too many tabs to fit in the container width. When the button is disabled (i.e. the first tab is visible), it appears semi-transparent.
icons.decrement_highlight: Icon for the left arrow button that appears when there are too many tabs to fit in the container width. Used when the button is being hovered with the cursor.
icons.drop_mark: Icon shown to indicate where a dragged tab will be dropped (see drag_to_rearrange_enabled).
icons.increment: Icon for the right arrow button that appears when there are too many tabs to fit in the container width. When the button is disabled (i.e. the last tab is visible) it appears semi-transparent.
icons.increment_highlight: Icon for the right arrow button that appears when there are too many tabs to fit in the container width. Used when the button is being hovered with the cursor.

styles.button_highlight: Background of the tab and close buttons when they're being hovered with the cursor.
styles.button_pressed: Background of the tab and close buttons when it's being pressed.
styles.tab_focus: StyleBox used when the TabBar is focused. The tab_focus StyleBox is displayed over the base StyleBox of the selected tab, so a partially transparent StyleBox should be used to ensure the base StyleBox remains visible. A StyleBox that represents an outline or an underline works well for this purpose. To disable the focus visual effect, assign a StyleBoxEmpty resource. Note that disabling the focus visual effect will harm keyboard/controller navigation usability, so this is not recommended for accessibility reasons.
styles.tab_hovered: The style of the currently hovered tab. Does not apply to the selected tab. Note: This style will be drawn with the same width as tab_unselected at minimum.
styles.tab_selected: The style of the currently selected tab.
styles.tab_unselected: The style of the other, unselected tabs.

colors.drop_mark_color: Modulation color for the drop_mark icon.
colors.font_hovered_color: Font color of the currently hovered tab. Does not apply to the selected tab.
colors.font_outline_color: The tint of text outline of the tab name.
colors.font_selected_color: Font color of the currently selected tab.
colors.font_unselected_color: Font color of the other, unselected tabs.
colors.icon_hovered_color: Icon color of the currently hovered tab. Does not apply to the selected tab.
colors.icon_selected_color: Icon color of the currently selected tab.
colors.icon_unselected_color: Icon color of the other, unselected tabs.

constants.icon_max_width: The maximum allowed width of the tab's icon. This limit is applied on top of the default size of the icon, but before the value set with TabBar.set_tab_icon_max_width. The height is adjusted according to the icon's ratio.
constants.icon_separation: Space between tab's name and its icon.
constants.outline_size: The size of the tab text outline. Note: If using a font with FontFile.multichannel_signed_distance_field enabled, its FontFile.msdf_pixel_range must be set to at least twice the value of outline_size for outline rendering to look correct. Otherwise, the outline may appear to be cut off earlier than intended.
constants.side_margin: The space at the left or right edges of the tab bar, accordingly with the current tab_alignment. The margin is ignored with TabBar.ALIGNMENT_RIGHT if the tabs are clipped (see clip_tabs) or a popup has been set (see set_popup). The margin is always ignored with TabBar.ALIGNMENT_CENTER.
constants.tab_separation: The space between tabs in the tab bar.

font_sizes.font_size: Font size of the tab names.

fonts.font: The font used to draw tab names.

icons.decrement: Icon for the left arrow button that appears when there are too many tabs to fit in the container width. When the button is disabled (i.e. the first tab is visible), it appears semi-transparent.
icons.decrement_highlight: Icon for the left arrow button that appears when there are too many tabs to fit in the container width. Used when the button is being hovered with the cursor.
icons.drop_mark: Icon shown to indicate where a dragged tab will be dropped (see drag_to_rearrange_enabled).
icons.increment: Icon for the right arrow button that appears when there are too many tabs to fit in the container width. When the button is disabled (i.e. the last tab is visible) it appears semi-transparent.
icons.increment_highlight: Icon for the right arrow button that appears when there are too many tabs to fit in the container width. Used when the button is being hovered with the cursor.
icons.menu: The icon for the menu button (see set_popup).
icons.menu_highlight: The icon for the menu button (see set_popup) when it's being hovered with the cursor.

styles.panel: The style for the background fill.
styles.tab_focus: StyleBox used when the TabBar is focused. The tab_focus StyleBox is displayed over the base StyleBox of the selected tab, so a partially transparent StyleBox should be used to ensure the base StyleBox remains visible. A StyleBox that represents an outline or an underline works well for this purpose. To disable the focus visual effect, assign a StyleBoxEmpty resource. Note that disabling the focus visual effect will harm keyboard/controller navigation usability, so this is not recommended for accessibility reasons.
styles.tab_hovered: The style of the currently hovered tab. Note: This style will be drawn with the same width as tab_unselected at minimum.
styles.tab_selected: The style of the currently selected tab.
styles.tab_unselected: The style of the other, unselected tabs.
styles.tabbar_background: The style for the background fill of the TabBar area.

colors.background_color: Sets the background Color of this TextEdit.
colors.caret_background_color: Color of the text behind the caret when using a block caret.
colors.caret_color: Color of the caret. This can be set to a fully transparent color to hide the caret entirely.
colors.current_line_color: Background Color of the line containing the caret.
colors.font_outline_color: The tint of text outline of the TextEdit.
colors.font_readonly_color: Sets the font Color when editable is disabled.
colors.font_selected_color: Sets the Color of the selected text. If equal to Color(0, 0, 0, 0), it will be ignored.
colors.search_result_border_color: Color of the border around text that matches the search query.
colors.search_result_color: Color behind the text that matches the search query.
colors.selection_color: Sets the highlight Color of text selections.
colors.word_highlighted_color: Sets the highlight Color of multiple occurrences. highlight_all_occurrences has to be enabled.

constants.caret_width: The caret's width in pixels. Greater values can be used to improve accessibility by ensuring the caret is easily visible, or to ensure consistency with a large font size. If set to 0 or lower, the caret width is automatically set to 1 pixel and multiplied by the display scaling factor.
constants.line_spacing: Additional vertical spacing between lines (in pixels), spacing is added to line descent. This value can be negative.
constants.outline_size: The size of the text outline. Note: If using a font with FontFile.multichannel_signed_distance_field enabled, its FontFile.msdf_pixel_range must be set to at least twice the value of outline_size for outline rendering to look correct. Otherwise, the outline may appear to be cut off earlier than intended.
constants.wrap_offset: Sets an additional margin for line wrapping width.

icons.space: Sets a custom Texture2D for space text characters.
icons.tab: Sets a custom Texture2D for tab text characters.

styles.focus: Sets the StyleBox when in focus. The focus StyleBox is displayed over the base StyleBox, so a partially transparent StyleBox should be used to ensure the base StyleBox remains visible. A StyleBox that represents an outline or an underline works well for this purpose. To disable the focus visual effect, assign a StyleBoxEmpty resource. Note that disabling the focus visual effect will harm keyboard/controller navigation usability, so this is not recommended for accessibility reasons.
styles.normal: Sets the StyleBox of this TextEdit.
styles.read_only: Sets the StyleBox of this TextEdit when editable is disabled.

colors.children_hl_line_color: The Color of the relationship lines between the selected TreeItem and its children.
colors.custom_button_font_highlight: Text Color for a TreeItem.CELL_MODE_CUSTOM mode cell when it's hovered.
colors.drop_on_item_color: Color used to draw the highlight outline when dragging items that can only be dropped "on" other items.
colors.drop_position_color: Color used to draw possible drop locations. See DropModeFlags constants for further description of drop locations.
colors.font_color: Default text Color of the item.
colors.font_disabled_color: Text Color for a TreeItem.CELL_MODE_CHECK mode cell when it's non-editable (see TreeItem.set_editable).
colors.font_hovered_color: Text Color used when the item is hovered and not selected yet.
colors.font_hovered_dimmed_color: Text Color used when the item is hovered, while a button of the same item is hovered as the same time.
colors.font_hovered_selected_color: Text Color used when the item is hovered and selected.
colors.font_outline_color: The tint of text outline of the item.
colors.font_selected_color: Text Color used when the item is selected.
colors.parent_hl_line_color: The Color of the relationship lines between the selected TreeItem and its parents.
colors.relationship_line_color: The default Color of the relationship lines.
colors.scroll_hint_color: Color used to modulate the scroll_hint texture.
colors.title_button_color: Default text Color of the title button.

constants.button_margin: The horizontal space between each button in a cell.
constants.check_h_separation: The horizontal space between the checkbox and the text in a TreeItem.CELL_MODE_CHECK mode cell.
constants.children_hl_line_width: The width of the relationship lines between the selected TreeItem and its children.
constants.dragging_unfold_wait_msec: During a drag-and-drop, this is how many milliseconds to wait over a section before the section unfolds.
constants.draw_guides: Draws the guidelines if not zero, this acts as a boolean. The guideline is a horizontal line drawn at the bottom of each item.
constants.draw_relationship_lines: Draws the relationship lines if not zero, this acts as a boolean. Relationship lines are drawn at the start of child items to show hierarchy.
constants.h_separation: The horizontal space between item cells. This is also used as the margin at the start of an item when folding is disabled.
constants.icon_h_separation: The horizontal space between the icon and the text in item's cells.
constants.icon_max_width: The maximum allowed width of the icon in item's cells. This limit is applied on top of the default size of the icon, but before the value set with TreeItem.set_icon_max_width. The height is adjusted according to the icon's ratio.
constants.inner_item_margin_bottom: The inner bottom margin of a cell.
constants.inner_item_margin_left: The inner left margin of a cell.
constants.inner_item_margin_right: The inner right margin of a cell.
constants.inner_item_margin_top: The inner top margin of a cell.
constants.item_margin: The horizontal margin at the start of an item. This is used when folding is enabled for the item.
constants.outline_size: The size of the text outline. Note: If using a font with FontFile.multichannel_signed_distance_field enabled, its FontFile.msdf_pixel_range must be set to at least twice the value of outline_size for outline rendering to look correct. Otherwise, the outline may appear to be cut off earlier than intended.
constants.parent_hl_line_margin: The space between the parent relationship lines for the selected TreeItem and the relationship lines to its siblings that are not selected.
constants.parent_hl_line_width: The width of the relationship lines between the selected TreeItem and its parents.
constants.relationship_line_width: The default width of the relationship lines.
constants.scroll_border: The maximum distance between the mouse cursor and the control's border to trigger border scrolling when dragging.
constants.scroll_max_sticky_items: The maximum number of tree items allowed to stick to the top while its children are in view. A value of 0 disables sticking.
constants.scrollbar_h_separation: The horizontal separation of tree content and scrollbar.
constants.scrollbar_margin_bottom: The bottom margin of the scrollbars. When negative, uses panel bottom margin.
constants.scrollbar_margin_left: The left margin of the horizontal scrollbar. When negative, uses panel left margin.
constants.scrollbar_margin_right: The right margin of the scrollbars. When negative, uses panel right margin.
constants.scrollbar_margin_top: The top margin of the vertical scrollbar. When negative, uses panel top margin.
constants.scrollbar_v_separation: The vertical separation of tree content and scrollbar.
constants.v_separation: The vertical padding inside each item, i.e. the distance between the item's content and top/bottom border.

font_sizes.font_size: Font size of the item's text.
font_sizes.title_button_font_size: Font size of the title button's text.

fonts.title_button_font: Font of the title button's text.

icons.arrow: The arrow icon used when a foldable item is not collapsed.
icons.arrow_collapsed: The arrow icon used when a foldable item is collapsed (for left-to-right layouts).
icons.arrow_collapsed_mirrored: The arrow icon used when a foldable item is collapsed (for right-to-left layouts).
icons.checked: The check icon to display when the TreeItem.CELL_MODE_CHECK mode cell is checked and editable (see TreeItem.set_editable).
icons.checked_disabled: The check icon to display when the TreeItem.CELL_MODE_CHECK mode cell is checked and non-editable (see TreeItem.set_editable).
icons.indeterminate: The check icon to display when the TreeItem.CELL_MODE_CHECK mode cell is indeterminate and editable (see TreeItem.set_editable).
icons.indeterminate_disabled: The check icon to display when the TreeItem.CELL_MODE_CHECK mode cell is indeterminate and non-editable (see TreeItem.set_editable).
icons.scroll_hint: The indicator that will be shown when the content can still be scrolled. See scroll_hint_mode.
icons.select_arrow: The arrow icon to display for the TreeItem.CELL_MODE_RANGE mode cell.
icons.unchecked: The check icon to display when the TreeItem.CELL_MODE_CHECK mode cell is unchecked and editable (see TreeItem.set_editable).
icons.unchecked_disabled: The check icon to display when the TreeItem.CELL_MODE_CHECK mode cell is unchecked and non-editable (see TreeItem.set_editable).
icons.updown: The updown arrow icon to display for the TreeItem.CELL_MODE_RANGE mode cell.

styles.button_hover: StyleBox used when a button in the tree is hovered.
styles.button_pressed: StyleBox used when a button in the tree is pressed.
styles.cursor: StyleBox used for the cursor, when the Tree is being focused.
styles.cursor_unfocused: StyleBox used for the cursor, when the Tree is not being focused.
styles.custom_button: Default StyleBox for a TreeItem.CELL_MODE_CUSTOM mode cell when button is enabled with TreeItem.set_custom_as_button.
styles.custom_button_hover: StyleBox for a TreeItem.CELL_MODE_CUSTOM mode button cell when it's hovered.
styles.custom_button_pressed: StyleBox for a TreeItem.CELL_MODE_CUSTOM mode button cell when it's pressed.
styles.focus: The focused style for the Tree, drawn on top of everything.
styles.hovered: StyleBox for the item being hovered, but not selected.
styles.hovered_dimmed: StyleBox for the item being hovered, while a button of the same item is hovered as the same time.
styles.hovered_selected: StyleBox for the hovered and selected items, used when the Tree is not being focused.
styles.hovered_selected_focus: StyleBox for the hovered and selected items, used when the Tree is being focused.
styles.panel: The background style for the Tree.
styles.selected: StyleBox for the selected items, used when the Tree is not being focused.
styles.selected_focus: StyleBox for the selected items, used when the Tree is being focused.
styles.title_button_hover: StyleBox used when the title button is being hovered.
styles.title_button_normal: Default StyleBox for the title button.
styles.title_button_pressed: StyleBox used when the title button is being pressed.

constants.padding_left: Padding between the left of the ScrollBar.scroll element and the ScrollBar.grabber. Note: To apply vertical padding, modify the top/bottom content margins of ScrollBar.scroll instead.
constants.padding_right: Padding between the right of the ScrollBar.scroll element and the ScrollBar.grabber. Note: To apply vertical padding, modify the top/bottom content margins of ScrollBar.scroll instead.

colors.title_color: The color of the title's text.
colors.title_outline_modulate: The color of the title's text outline.

constants.close_h_offset: Horizontal position offset of the close button, relative to the end of the title bar, towards the beginning of the title bar.
constants.close_v_offset: Vertical position offset of the close button, relative to the bottom of the title bar, towards the top of the title bar.
constants.resize_margin: Defines the outside margin at which the window border can be grabbed with mouse and resized.
constants.title_outline_size: The size of the title outline.

font_sizes.title_font_size: The size of the title font.

fonts.title_font: The font used to draw the title.

icons.close: The icon for the close button.
icons.close_pressed: The icon for the close button when it's being pressed.

styles.embedded_border: The background style used when the Window is embedded. Note that this is drawn only under the window's content, excluding the title. For proper borders and title bar style, you can use expand_margin_* properties of StyleBoxFlat. Note: The content background will not be visible unless transparent is enabled.
styles.embedded_unfocused_border: The background style used when the Window is embedded and unfocused.
